source.title: CyberMaskQA: A Privacy-Aware Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Cybersecurity Question Answering

claire_radar.whyItMatters: The evaluation gap is the lack of context-rich datasets for privacy-preserving QA in cybersecurity, which hinders progress. This benchmark's value is in enabling controlled information disclosure and studying privacy-utility trade-offs for deployable models.
